name: TimeField
summary: A typed time in parts: hours, minutes (and seconds), plus AM or PM on a 12-hour clock, in the locale's order. Each part takes digits and moves on by itself, steps with the arrow keys and clears with Backspace. Not for a duration ("1 h 30 min": a NumberField with a unit) or for picking from available slots (a list of times).
a11y: A `group` named by the label; each part is a `spinbutton` with its own name ("Hours"), its value in words and its range. Each part is a tab stop; left and right also move between parts. A part that isn't filled says "Empty". The parts sit left to right in every language, as clocks do.

keys.action: one more or less (minutes by `step`); wraps
types into the part, then moves on

props.name: label
props.description: What the time is for, sentence case: "Start time", "Reminder".

props.name: value
props.description: The time as `HH:MM` (or `HH:MM:SS` with `seconds`) on the 24-hour clock, or null when empty.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new time once every part is filled, or null when it is cleared.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes each arrow press moves, e.g. 15 for a booking. Typing still takes any minute. Defaults to 1.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: 12 or 24 hours; defaults to the locale's clock.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the clock and the AM/PM words; defaults to the page's.
